types.name: Nuclear plant
types.description: Every nuclear power plant in service; the value is the capacity of its reactors. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Pumped-storage plant
types.description: Pumped-storage hydro of at least 300 MW per hex: two reservoirs that work as the grid's battery. Plants of the same kind in one hex count as one site. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Tidal power station
types.description: Tidal power stations of at least 100 MW: La Rance, in Brittany, is Europe's only large one.

types.name: Hydroelectric plant
types.description: Hydroelectric plants (reservoir and run-of-river) of at least 300 MW per hex. Plants of the same kind in one hex count as one site. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Coal plant
types.description: Hard-coal and lignite plants of at least 300 MW per hex. Plants of the same kind in one hex count as one site. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Gas plant
types.description: Natural-gas plants (combined cycles, gas turbines, cogeneration) of at least 500 MW per hex. Plants of the same kind in one hex count as one site. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Geothermal plant
types.description: Geothermal power plants of at least 50 MW per hex (Tuscany's Larderello field, Iceland). Plants of the same kind in one hex count as one site. Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Wind farms
types.description: Onshore wind where a hex adds up to at least 250 MW, and offshore wind farms (moved to the nearest coast of their country) where they add up to at least 200 MW on one coastal hex. Every installation in the hex is added up (wind turbines are often filed one by one). Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Solar parks
types.description: Ground-mounted solar where a hex adds up to at least 250 MW (rooftops and installations under 1 MW are not counted). Every installation in the hex is added up (wind turbines are often filed one by one). Only plants in service in 2026 count (those due to close in 2026 say so).

types.name: Battery storage
types.description: Grid batteries where a hex adds up to at least 100 MW, counting only installations with a commissioning year (from 2012). Every installation in the hex is added up (wind turbines are often filed one by one).

types.name: Vineyards
types.description: Hexes where at least 12% of the land is vineyards (CORINE class 221), thinned to about one hex in four on a regular lattice; the value is the vineyard share of the hex's land, in percent.
